project_type: FileForgeWorkbench (ffwb) -- a Rust Cargo workspace of ~90 crates building an egui/eframe desktop mainframe-dataset workbench. This task touches the dataset stack: a NEW narrow model crate ff-volume and the SQLite-backed catalog crate ff-dscatalog.
build_system: Cargo workspace. Root Cargo.toml lists `members`. Shared versions in [workspace.dependencies]. A custom `cargo gate` subcommand runs the full completion gate (fmt + clippy --workspace + nextest + build) -- that is the OWNER's manual step, NEVER run by the coder.
test_framework: Rust built-in #[test] + proptest + pretty_assertions + tempfile. Full runs use cargo-nextest. The coder uses SCOPED `cargo test -p <crate>` only.
test_command: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-volume" (and -p ff-dscatalog). NEVER --workspace, NEVER cargo gate.
verification_instructions: Per testing.md: TDD -- write a failing test with a `// Validates: Requirement X.Y` comment, confirm red via `cargo test -p <crate> <name>`, implement the minimum, confirm green. After each FEAT and at the end run (via the pwsh7 wrapper) `cargo check -p <crate>`, `cargo test -p <crate>`, `cargo clippy -p <crate> -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt`. Then STOP and hand off to the owner for the full `cargo gate --build`. Do NOT self-certify the full gate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. SQLite catalog DBs are created at runtime/in tests via tempfile; no checked-in generated artifacts for this task.
environment_constraints: Windows. Use C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "<one command>" for EVERY shell command (per tooling.md) -- no `;`-chaining, no process-kill glued on, one command per invocation; a PreToolUse guard hook blocks violations. Use read/grep/glob dedicated tools for file inspection, not Get-Content/Select-String. Redirect script output to tools\logs\ and read it back. Edits are DIRECTLY on branch main in c:\workspace\VSC\FileForgeWorkbench -- NO worktree, NO new branch, NO commit (leave uncommitted). This OVERRIDES any generic 'commit locally' guidance. Do NOT touch .worktrees/vsam-wiring (a separate active work stream).
contribution_requirements: rust-standards.md: 400-non-test-line hard cap per .rs file (split by concern _state/_render/_commands/etc.); 40-line function guideline; newtypes over primitives; thiserror in library crates, no unwrap/expect in lib code; #[non_exhaustive] on public enums that may grow; ASCII-only in .rs with `// === Name ===` separators. documentation.md: plain ASCII in docs (no em dash U+2014, use `--`; no curly quotes). testing.md: every test maps to a Requirement via a `// Validates:` comment; split a test module to a sibling *_tests.rs before it exceeds ~200 lines. framework-conformance.md + wiring-standard.md: build ON the framework; ff-volume is a narrow model crate and MUST NOT depend on ff-dscatalog/ff-dsalloc/ff-idcams (acyclic DAG ff-dscatalog -> ff-volume -> ff-vfs).
key_patterns: ff-dscatalog/src/schema.rs: SCHEMA_VERSION is a `pub const &str` ('3' today); MIGRATIONS is a `&[(&str,&str)]` where MIGRATIONS[idx] upgrades version idx+1 -> idx+2 (so v3->v4 is index 2); apply_migrations reads schema_version from catalog_metadata, runs each pending SQL batch in order, bumps the stored version. initialize_database CREATEs all tables + sets WAL + inserts default metadata. Datasets currently carry a `storage_path` TEXT NOT NULL column; DatasetRecord (dataset.rs) mirrors it. Resolution: catalog_registry.rs::resolve / resolve_scoped build ResolveResult { entry, catalog_name, physical_path } by joining catalog.repository_path() + entry.storage_path. ff-vfs/src/storage_provider.rs defines `trait StorageProvider` + `StorageLocator(opaque String)` + `StorageCapability` -- the physical URI/locator seam a Volume's storage_uri maps onto (ADR-001). CatalogError (error.rs) is a #[non_exhaustive] thiserror enum with `[catalog] {operation}: ...` Display format; add new variants there. NOTE: ff-dscatalog::vsam_service already exports an `AccessMode` -- the new ff_volume::AccessMode is a DIFFERENT type; import it qualified, do not glob.
